verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing page lists 'Pipeline management' as a feature, and its docs describe Deals as a first-party object type you can read and write. That confirms deal tracking exists, but nothing in the pack describes a visual board, customizable stages, or drag-and-drop updates. missing for 10: evidence of a visual/kanban pipeline view, customizable stage configuration, drag-and-drop stage updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: Deals are read and written with the custom object endpoints, with `Deals` as the `objectType` path parameter.
